text: Return policy: Unopened items in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
Return policy: Perishable items such as produce, dairy, and frozen goods cannot be returned once delivered unless they arrive damaged or spoiled.
Return policy: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is received and inspected.
Delivery policy: Standard delivery is free for orders over $35 and takes 1 to 2 business days in most areas.
Delivery policy: Same-day delivery is available for orders placed before 2 PM local time, subject to a delivery fee and zip-code coverage.
Membership policy: Membership provides free standard delivery, exclusive discounts, and rewards points on eligible purchases.
Allergy and quality policy: We partner directly with farms and suppliers to ensure fresh, quality products; report any quality issue within 24 hours of delivery.
Billing policy: Payment is charged at checkout; products are priced at the time of order, and any price adjustment is applied as a store credit.
